notes.title: 《Lover》is now available!
notes.notes:
Lover is a first-person psychological horror game.
Presented in a nostalgic and retro environment, player will uncover the cause of the illness through reincarnation and overcome psychological issues.
Before darkness consumes your world, find those unspeakable secrets as you face the cold house and shattered reality.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2759710/_/

notes.title: Coming Soon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837806/5f6fb1bb4c2630ae3e0e86d2ec5e70924c350546.png[/img]

I'm excited to announce that the game development has been completed and will be released on Steam on February 29, 2024, Pacific Time.
Lover is an indie game with elements that pay respect to classic horror games such as PT and Layers of Fear, and is dedicated to designing an exquisite piece of work.

Finally, don't forget to add to wishlist.
